entries.title: Psalms 21:1
segments: The Lord's salvation is the joy and rejoicing of his people.  They glory in it, as the ground of all their present blessings, and all their future hopes.

entries.title: Psalms 21:3
segments: Preventest him; meetest him as a friend and helper.

entries.title: Psalms 21:4
segments: He asked life of thee; the life here spoken of seems not to be simply David's life as a man, but to include the life of his successors upon the throne which was to be perpetuated "for ever and ever" in Christ.

entries.title: Psalms 21:5
segments: Honor and majesty hast thou laid upon him; by establishing the throne of his kingdom for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 21:8
segments: However long God may bear with the wicked, and however numerous the blessings which he may bestow upon them, if his blessings do not lead them to repentance, but are abused, they will only be the means of ripening them for a more aggravated destruction.

entries.title: Psalms 21:9
segments: As a fiery oven; utterly consuming them.
